newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig cut to hold.

text.p: -- Kleinwort Benson said on Wednesday it had cut its rating for Brazilian electric power company Cemig SA to hold from buy.

-- "Although the company's operating income shows a significant improvement, lower-than-expected financial income and higher-than-anticipated operating costs have caused us to lower our earnings estimates for Cemig," analyst Cecilia Tam wrote in a report.
-- "In addition the uncertainties surrounding this year's tariff adjustment have also caused us to lower our tariff assumptions and consequently revenue figures.

-- "Although we believe that Cemig's plans for a strategic partner are positive ... it may be difficult for the state of Minas Gerais to find a buyer which is willing to pay $1 billion for a 33 percent stake in the ordinary shares."

-- Tam added, "Given the uncertainties around finding the strategic partner at the state's current asking price and the lower-than-expected results, we are recommending clients take profits and are downgrading our recommendation."
